title: myosotis gussonei
intro: Myosotis gussonei, commonly known as alpine forget-me-not, is a species of flowering plant in the family Boraginaceae. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal issues and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of M. gussonei include its potential to protect against liver damage and its ability to exert antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents of M. gussonei include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
